case_number: 2024 INSC 175; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NOS 10159-10168 OF 2020

parties.respondent: The State of Tamil Nadu & Ors

summary: Environmental violation closure upheld; 22-year non-compliance with pollution norms; hazardous waste mismanagement; copper slag dumping causing river flooding; groundwater and air pollution; failed green belt requirements; High Court jurisdiction validated; Article 136 interference unwarranted despite procedural challenges; closure order sustained for persistent ecological harm.
final_judgment: Special Leave Petitions dismissed; closure of copper smelter at Thoothukudi upheld.
